name: animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
description: An animated beam of light which travels along a path. Useful for showcasing the integration features of a website.

props.name: containerRef
props.description: A ref to a positioned (`relative`) element that contains both ends.

props.name: fromRef
props.description: A ref to the element the beam starts from.

props.name: toRef
props.description: A ref to the element the beam travels to.

props.name: curvature
props.description: Bend of the path in pixels. Negative curves up, positive curves down.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Run the beam from `toRef` back to `fromRef`.

props.name: repeat
props.description: How many times the beam repeats.

props.name: startXOffset
props.description: Horizontal offset of the start point in pixels.

props.name: startYOffset
props.description: Vertical offset of the start point in pixels.

props.name: endXOffset
props.description: Horizontal offset of the end point in pixels.

props.name: endYOffset
props.description: Vertical offset of the end point in pixels.
